DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection).

I have reached my diagnosis limit after gathering key details: a 22-year-old pregnant patient at 30 weeks gestation presenting with fever, headache, and malaise following the ingestion of ice cream three days prior. This clinical picture is highly suggestive of listeriosis, a known risk associated with unpasteurized dairy products in pregnancy. I will proceed with immediate treatment protocols for suspected Listeria infection.
